evidence.observation: Ramp reached 749.2 °C against 749.6 °C setpoint; Ar 100.4 sccm against 100; controller running.
Growth transition showed transient temperature overshoot to 760.1 °C with heater power reduced to 38.5%.
Temperature settled to 749.8 °C against 750 °C setpoint; heater power 45.9%, Ar 99.6 sccm against 100, status running; no persistent deviation apparent.
Pressure and exhaust oxygen sensors are not installed; null readings do not indicate a sensor fault.

args.missing_evidence: Sample characterization is required to assess target growth; pressure and oxygen measurements would be needed to independently verify atmosphere and exhaust conditions not covered by installed sensors.
